### ① Derived judgments

Rendered in-seat by the skills seat 1 session at the served tier the maintainer named on this date (the fable tier word at `get_session` → `external_metadata.last_served_model`; ruling record 5771798588). Card #19680 is the maintainer's direct-dispatch reversal of #19544 / PR #19573; the contract is the three sentences on the card body, quoted verbatim there and in the diff.

- **(a) The two values move back, and only the two values — right.** `git diff 97f4f8c c39a60e` is one file, +50 / −12: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` set to the fable id (:12282, was the opus id), `RETIRED_TIER_WORDS = Object.freeze([])` (:12542, was `['fable']`). `TIER_CEILING = tierWordOf(CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER)` (:12523) is untouched and derives the ceiling back to the fable word; `tierWordOf`, the exits docblock (「a tier EXHAUSTED means the default tier, never lower; a RETIRED tier is a maintainer ruling」), the ladder line and every rendering that reads the constant are kept — deriving the ceiling from the constant is what stops the pair drifting in either direction, and PR #19573's structurally sound half is exactly that. A grep for the opus id over the file at this head finds 0 occurrences: it was spelled only at the constant, so no rendering carries a literal.
- **(b) The renders — measured by this seat on a clean worktree at this head.** `--tier .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` prints 「Model tier — MANDATORY:」 followed by the fable id and 「(derived from the file surface, not recalled)」; `--tier scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` prints 「no path-derived mandate … (floor sonnet · default opus · ceiling fable)」. Both are what the card's acceptance asks for.
- **(c) The retired-spelling guard on an empty list — right, and non-vacuous.** The guard now runs through one function both legs call, `retiredWordHits` (:25513–:25514), so the live reading and its control run the same search. Four cases replace three (:25515–:25520): the live list clears every rendering (「dirty: none」); 「no tier word is RETIRED today — the list is empty and frozen」; the control on a MUTATED copy — a list naming the ladder's own ceiling word must red, printed on every run as the hits it finds; and the invariant the copy stands for — no word still in the ladder (`TIER_FLOOR`, `TIER_DEFAULT`, `TIER_CEILING`) may enter the live list. The old pin 「names at least one word」 (which could not hold on `[]`) is the only case removed. The dev's ablation — the fable word put back into the list on a copy through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `f04cb35cdb94` → `2d7ada7ab81a` on disk — reds exactly the three predicted cases of 1906 and restores byte-identical to HEAD: the guard is proved from the mutated copy, not from the empty list.
- **(d) The docblock principle — right, and it quotes rather than restates.** :12258–:12281 states the third case as one rule with the three sentences of 2026-09-22 verbatim, untranslated, and the ruling record by comment id: a tier word is RETIRED only by the maintainer's explicit ruling that names a retirement; a 429, an exhausted quota or a missing authorization on one session is ⛔ never a retirement; a seat this tier is not served to renders the review through an isolated at-tier subagent or waits outside the queue — ⛔ never by editing this line. 「What one session is authorized for is a property of that session; this constant is a property of the lane's governance」 is the sentence the reversal needed. The `RETIRED_TIER_WORDS` docblock (:12525–:12541) states EMPTY as the correct steady state, ⛔ not a disabled guard. SKILL.md:516 (「档位值单源在 dispatch-gates 常量」) makes this file the principle's home; ⛔ no `.claude/**` line is touched, as the card requires (the reference's 降档保险丝 section is #19061 step ②'s deletion).
- **(e) Pin disposition across PR #19573's six hunks — right.** Values inverted (1); the exits docblock kept (2), tier-agnostic; `tierWordOf` + derived ceiling kept, the list emptied with its docblock rewritten (3); the ladder line reading the derivation kept and printing 「ceiling fable」 again (4); the exits rendering reading `TIER_DEFAULT` kept (5); every self-test case kept except the one that cannot hold on an empty list (6). No pin in `scripts/pm` or `.claude` asserted the opus VALUE or 「the contract-review tier sits at the default-tier constant」 — measured by grep, and this seat's own grep agrees.
- **(f) Two pins this PR leaves for #19061 step ② — named, not this diff's.** :25548–:25549 read `references/contract-review.md` and assert its two 降档保险丝 lines; the maintainer's 「降档保险丝 不留」 (5772289798) deletes that section under step ②, which reds those two cases. The seat has instructed the step-② dev to retire exactly those two in its PR as a declared surface increment (region-level concurrency with this PR; the later lander merges once). Nothing in this PR is wrong about them: at this head the section still exists and the pins pass.
- **(g) Nothing narrowed or widened past the ruling.** The card is a value reversal plus its rationale; no ladder step, glob or exit code changes. Three of PR #19573's acceptance notes are cleared by the revert with no edit (`checklist-test/SKILL.md:103`'s ladder sentence, `check-dispatch-gates.mjs:263`'s 「fable-mandatory surface」, `SKILL.md:538`'s quota exemption having room again) and are recorded in the PR body so nobody files them.
- **(h) Batteries — measured by this seat at this head.** `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --self-test` 1140 cases (it imports the constant and is not derived by `--commands` for this diff — the same blind spot PR #19573 reported; run by hand, green); `check:nul-bytes` exit 0; eslint over the file 0 / 0; `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (1906 cases, ~11 minutes, runs detached) — the dev reports exit 0 with the exit captured to a file; the seat's own run at this head is read before enqueue (③ below).
